title: mail-parser: One hostile attachment aborts `write_attachments()` and silently drops the rest of the batch…
description: A vulnerability in mail-parser versions 4.6.0 through 4.6.2 causes the write_attachments() function to abort and silently drop all subsequent attachments when encountering a single malicious attachment with crafted MIME metadata. This results in an evasion technique where a malicious attachment placed first prevents later payloads from being saved to disk, although they still reach the recipient's mail client intact. The issue is fixed in version 4.6.3, which improves filename validation, truncates overlong names, and moves base64 decoding before file creation to prevent zero-byte stubs. Users are advised to upgrade to 4.6.3 or implement manual attachment handling with error catching for untrusted mail.
